visual_rules: Core palette values are approved exactly as recorded in DN-DEC-006; do not approximate or substitute them.
Not every application must use every core palette color.
Dark Brown on Warm Ivory is documented at 15.71:1; Warm Gray on Warm Ivory at 4.31:1; Muted Teal on Warm Ivory at 2.7:1; Warm Orange on Warm Ivory at 3.20:1.
Do not use Muted Teal or Warm Orange as normal-sized text on Warm Ivory based on the documented contrast results; validate every actual foreground/background pairing before release.
The official Arabic name is ديجيتال نواة.
motion_rules: The approved symbol concept includes an interlocked D/N monogram with rising pixels.
No mandatory per-video motion sequence, timing, easing, or intro animation has been verified as approved.
outro_rules: The approved official tagline is Build. Innovate. Teach.
The tagline is not a mandatory outro for every video; apply it when the requested content and approved brand context call for a brand signature.
